prompt: Wrap a Function so that each distinct argument is computed only once: repeat arguments must return a cached result without calling the inner function again. Complete the onceOnly method in Throttle.
explanation: This is memoization: the returned lambda captures a HashMap created once per onceOnly call, so the cache lives as long as the returned Function does. Map.computeIfAbsent does the whole first-time-compute, otherwise-return-cached dance in one call, and it conveniently accepts the inner Function directly as the mapping function. Each call to onceOnly builds a separate map, so two wrapped functions never share cached results.
hints: Create the HashMap BEFORE returning the lambda; the lambda captures it and reuses it across calls.
cache.computeIfAbsent(arg, inner) calls inner only when arg has no cached value yet.
Without computeIfAbsent: if the map containsKey(arg), return cache.get(arg); otherwise apply inner, put the result, and return it.
